decision: Use a checked-in canonical stateful Qubes lease-fencing campaign manifest

criteria.correctness: Uses coordinator-issued mission IDs and lease tokens via captures; exercises expiry, same-worker reclaim, stale-token rejection, and current-token completion.
criteria.robustness: Deterministic request IDs and idempotency key make reruns diagnosable while the harness remains fail-closed on missing captures or unexpected responses.
criteria.latency: Adds one intentional 31s lease-expiry wait; wait metadata is excluded from transport p95 so readiness latency is not distorted.
criteria.resourceUse: No daemon, database, or additional service; one qrexec process per request as in the production-shaped harness.
criteria.regressionRisk: No production semantics changed; the manifest composes existing submit/claim/complete and fencing contracts.
criteria.qa: Existing harness and collector tests cover capture resolution, wait validation, stale-probe semantics, and zero duplicate/unresolved counters. CI must be green on the manifest commit before a real Qubes run is accepted.

alternatives.name: manual-shell-sequence
alternatives.reason: Human copy/paste of mission IDs and lease tokens is error-prone, hard to replay, and weak evidence for readiness.

alternatives.name: hard-coded-mission-and-token-fixture
alternatives.reason: Would not prove that the real coordinator-issued fencing token survives qrexec process boundaries and reclaim.

alternatives.name: test-only-short-lease-production-hook
alternatives.reason: Faster, but changes the production-shaped service contract and risks certifying behavior that differs from the real 30s lease lifecycle.

failureLessons: A QA-barrier probe is not a post-join completion check: if QA is claimable, that probe intentionally records a blocker. Keep lease-fencing evidence focused and run the existing QA-before-join probe separately.
Intentional lease waits are campaign-control evidence, not qrexec round-trip latency samples.
REAL-WORKER readiness still requires a real Qube-to-Qube run with matching provenance/topology/commit and all readiness counters passing.
